points.quote: What may be a valuable application of AI for your own learning, knowledge or academic development may be poor academic practice or misconduct in assessment.
points.gist: An AI use that is valuable for your own learning may be poor practice or misconduct in assessment.

points.quote: It's vital that when approaching any assignment you ensure that the work is your own or that you have followed any guidelines or expectations about the use of AI set by your module leader.
points.gist: For any assignment, ensure the work is your own or that you followed the module leader's AI guidelines or expectations.

points.quote: Generally speaking, if you are using generative AI to support you learning and academic development, you are unlikely to need to acknowledge it.
points.gist: If you use generative AI to support your learning and development, you are unlikely to need to acknowledge it.

points.quote: However, if you are using it to support the preparation of an assessed piece of work, you will need to acknowledge in an open and transparent way how and why you have used AI for the development of your work.
points.gist: If you use AI to prepare assessed work, you must openly acknowledge how and why you used it.

points.quote: you must include an in text citation and reference.
points.gist: You must include an in-text citation and reference.

points.quote: ensuring the work you submit represents your own effort and has not been extensively edited or enhanced by AI technology or another person
points.gist: Submitted work must represent your own effort and not be extensively edited or enhanced by AI technology or another person.

points.quote: your work will be considered within the Academic Misconduct Procedure and the Student Progress Service reserves the right to run work through an AI checker as part of an investigation into academic misconduct.
points.gist: Suspect work goes through the Academic Misconduct Procedure, and the Student Progress Service may run it through an AI checker in an investigation.

points.quote: claiming authorship of machine generated content (including text, code and creative works) means that you are not demonstrating your own skills and learning.
points.gist: Claiming authorship of machine-generated text, code or creative works means you are not demonstrating your own skills and learning.

points.quote: As University students you need to be aware of the potential uses of AI, how it can enhance your learning, while being cautious about becoming over reliant on AI to the detriment of your own academic development.
points.gist: Students need to know the potential uses of AI and how it can enhance learning, while being cautious about over-reliance.

points.quote: We've put together an AI for Learning Canvas course that provides practical advice, examples and resources to allow you to use generative AI productively and responsibly as part of your learning journey.
points.gist: An AI for Learning Canvas course offers practical advice, examples and resources for using generative AI productively and responsibly.

points.quote: Download our handy checklist featuring guidance for using AI responsibly at Newcastle University.
points.gist: A downloadable checklist gives guidance for using AI responsibly at Newcastle University.
